svg.title: TOPAK A3 — Fourteen boundaries on one picture: the boundary register mapped
svg.desc: Every boundary the 2026.09.13 register names, placed on the system it divides and tagged with its id. The register is dated: it was written against the 09.12 checkpoint, nothing in it is a ratified decision, and rows marked † are analysis with no record behind them. Where a later record has since changed a boundary, the change is stated as G10 and ToO rev 14 have it, in the last column of the register below.

At archetype custody removable only with their own consent, so at the gate: attributable non-principals, Mediated as attribution only (ADR-0002 A2, ToO §7.5). At degenerate
custody they become principals and the gate moves to the eviction or recovery rule.
Issue and Resign are environment events no principal can express. Intent is the sole axiom (ADR-0025): no theorem covers it.

text.tspan: B14 · Gate approver: outside every theorem

svg.text: Build: constitutive (HITL). Promotion needs every counted grant seat; grant-seat humans are principals, evictable by the anchor (ADR-0024, ToO §7.5). If they never show up, Build stalls.
Run: supervisory (HOTL). The window W is about a second; no human fits inside it. If the human never shows up, Run proceeds: HOTL is disabling only.
HOOTL: absent. The interval D was named and unbudgeted (†); ADR-0032 gives it a form, W + L + D < T_irrev, with L unmeasured.
Operators are principals (ADR-0050, provisional): when no operator in a domain holds a live lease, nothing in it is regranted and the domain stalls (ToO §7.10).
One principal holds exactly one seat; the agent is a cell of them (ADR-0037).
The Thinker holds a Persona: model, prompt, decoding, decoder, seat, pinned (ADR-0016).
Principal type: Contained or Mediated; rung 0 is Mediated, always.

text.tspan: Typed alphabet: the only way out

svg.text: Read Draft Invoke Emit Submit Vote: egress only (ADR-0022). Invoke is the whole attack surface.
operator seats, either domain, a person and no other seat: control requests, signed and decided by C1–C9 (ADR-0050; ADR-0037 A4).
grant seats vote (ADR-0024).
They read round topics, and nothing gates a read: the mechanism has no read path for topics (G10 item 46).
One principal holds exactly one seat; the agent is a cell of them (ADR-0037).
The Thinker holds a Persona: model, prompt, decoding, decoder, seat, pinned (ADR-0016).
Principal type: Contained or Mediated; rung 0 is Mediated, always.

text.tspan: Verified object: what is proved once, with the mechanism

svg.text: The admit path: epoch fence → lease → syntactic lift → floor → bundle →
consensus-ordered admit (ToO §15).
The mechanism release, its floor text, schema S and engine, pinned by digest.
Actions under a fenced epoch are rejected by mechanism, not policy: the
cheapest check.
Cedar, linked into the mechanism, resident (ADR-0012, ADR-0030). The text the
reference links is the proposed floor's emergency stage, 28 policies; the genesis
text stays a draft (G10 §2.2).
R1, R2, R5, R6, R7, R9 bound every anchor issuance (ADR-0026); R8 withdrawn
(W1); R6 and R7 change subject (A2, provisional).
Erasure, the one exception since X1 was retired (ADR-0041 A2; ADR-0013 A1),
plus the six forensic classes, as floor entries.
OPA/Rego, signed (ADR-0044), versioned; may subtract, never add. Change at incident cadence.
Promoted parameters; the decoder ships in the Persona, the validator in the mechanism (ADR-0018).
Per-axis declarations under ADR-0023: degenerate forms lose theorems, never gain capability.
refinements only:
subtraction
Contain is one component, instantiated twice: both membranes run this mechanism
Admits, denials, votes, issuances, heartbeats: actions, identities, ordering.
The archive keeps a hash and a pointer for each payload (ADR-0004).
Prompt text, commentary, raw emission: in a separately governed store built for deletion.
facts cross; payloads do not

text.tspan: Round topics: one per principal per round

svg.text: Sealed on emit completion (Build: at Submit); the topic is the unit of erasure (ADR-0003).
Erasure deletes sealed topics; crypto-shredding was rejected (ToO §4.3).
Admits, stop attribution, votes, issuances, break-glass, erasure events (ADR-0028, C1).
Deployment-stack vocabulary (register §10.1)
Effect exclusivity is assumed, not enforced (register §10.1). ADR-0034 now designs the discharge: rungs 0–3 and profile clauses P1–P7,
attested at lease grant. Narrowed, not closed: the node's launcher issues rung 1 on profiles that declare P3 fail, rung 3 only SIMULATED
(ADR-0033 A7); no real principal is Contained, and an operator or emergency seat is Mediated by design.

text.tspan: B12 · Deployment stack: sandbox and below
dated: written against the 09.12 checkpoint; nothing in it is ratified

svg.text: The first five columns are the register's §1 verbatim. † marks a row the register says is analysis with no ADR behind it; red marks the empty or undefined cells. The last column is this diagram's, drawn from G10 and ToO rev 14: what a later record changed at that boundary.

text.tspan: Since the register (state per G10, narrative per

svg.text: Release / incident
Promotion: signature over provenance
None claimed; Submit is sole egress
Fail-closed. Pipeline stalls; PC/EC makes this affordable

The single signing key is gone: promotion is a unanimous quorum grant of grant seats, votes bound to (artifact, gate-evidence, rules epoch) (ADR-0024). A promotion also stalls without the author's cell Observer's coverage to the seal (ADR-0024
A2, ADR-0039 §3, C4). A promotion seats: what is promoted may be a seating, whose tally grants a first lease (ADR-0024 A3, provisional; not built, G10 item 88).
Release / per-action
None; rejection is synchronous
Fail-closed. Resident default-deny floor, no fetch dependency

The floor is a Cedar library linked into the mechanism: no process, socket or fetch; admit ⟺ floor_permit ∧ ¬bundle_deny, any floor error a deny (ADR-0030 §1, §3, C1). The text linked since 2026.10.05 is the proposed floor's emergency

stage, genesis-provisional: ratified only when the bootstrap reviewer finds it fit, and no test of fitness is written (ADR-0030 A3; G10 items 2, 87). The operator crossed the criterion: once whoever reached a socket, now a principal on a seat
(ADR-0050, provisional); at the reference an unsigned BOOTSTRAP socket still seats.
Release (validator) / Persona (decoder)
Validate: total over floor alphabet
None for admissibility; unbounded for
Fail-closed. Parse failure is a local deny, monotone

Raw emission is retained at the archetype so the decoder can be re-run and compared: recovers faithfulness, not intent (ADR-0037 §3; D-0037-2 if not retained). Decoder–alphabet compatibility is still open (G9 item 17, as at G10). What comes back
in from the world now carries a label of its source, and an outward Actuate is refused by R5–R7 over clearSet (ADR-0047; ADR-0041 A1): a label is a declaration, not a finding (G10 §8).
Release / deploy / incident
Promotion: bundle ⊑ floor
Bundle staleness, unbounded but
Fail-closed and safe while stalled. The model case

The instant moved: bundle ⊑ floor now holds by composition at every admit, for every bundle at every age, and nobody decides it at promotion (ADR-0030 §1). A bundle loads only under an issued key's signature (ADR-0044, C1; built,
ADR-0033 A6), and only if its allowlist is well-formed (ADR-0049; ADR-0030 A2; built, A10).
Release / per-emission
Fact construction at Observer finding
None claimed
Fail-closed; no payload crosses by default (ADR-0004)

Unchanged in principle. Raw emission joins the payload side, beside the typed action (ADR-0004 B12, ADR-0037); the Reader stage's results cross as facts for the cell Observer (ToO §2.8). The Actuate envelope gains four label fields and a round
opens with its tool list (ADR-0042 A1). New readers that nothing gates: operators read each other's topics and an emergency seat's, and the mechanism has no read path for topics (G10 item 46).
Per-principal, static
Whole lease, for Mediated
N/A: predicate, not a runtime check (09.12 §5)

The lease carries [profile digest, rung] (ADR-0031 §3). Contained has four conjuncts (ADR-0034 §4); the fourth, lineage independence, is ADR-0035, Proposed, so no real principal is Contained. The reference's lookup answers yes only

for a SIMULATED rung-3 lease under a test-issued criterion: a witness, not a claim (G10 §2.3; ADR-0033 A7). An operator and an emergency seat are Mediated by design: a person is not confined (ADR-0050 §1; ADR-0052 §1, provisional).

text.tspan: B7 Seat LTRO separation of duties

svg.text: Release / Persona
Seat binding in Persona
None claimed
Fail-closed if binding is verified; unstated † (ADR-0016)

Seats are principals: a principal holds exactly one seat, the LTRO is a cell; Thinker and Observer are seats, Listener and Reader are stages (ADR-0037, C3, C4). Alphabets bounded by seat kind in floor text, forbid B10 and a tightened B6,

checked at the grant path first. Five kinds since Batch 34: operator and emergency join, each held only by a person (ADR-0037 A3, A4, provisional); B10 lets an emergency seat Actuate. The Listener labels and delivers the tool list, and stays a
stage (A2).
Provider (uncontrolled) / Persona
promotion
Undefined. Largest empty cell in the grid (§8)

Persona expiry now has a bound, not a clock: ttl ≤ T_persona at grant and every renewal (ADR-0031 A2; built, ADR-0033 A6), still read on the local clock (G9 item 62, open at G10). A revoked Persona is a targeted revocation (ToO §6). A
person's Persona binds a key, its lineage rooted in an identity provider whose key is issued (ADR-0016 A1; ADR-0025 A3, provisional). ToO §10 still calls B8 the most critical boundary.
Deploy / per-round
Seal on emit completion
Between emit and seal
Fail-closed on replay; fail-open on forensics † (ADR-0003,

Forensic floor: six classes non-erasable for the declared horizon (ADR-0028, C1). Crypto-shredding rejected. Topic identity carries the rules-epoch chain (A1) and a denials-only after companion (A2, C1). Genesis issues no erasure roster, so

erasure is disabled from epoch 0. F5 is now an emergency seating's activations and the calls under them (ToO §4.4); an activation's record kept only while its round is live breaks NC-1 and NC-2 (NonComposition_A1).
Constitutive / supervisory / absent
Gate (HITL) or non-refresh (passive e-stop)
D: unbudgeted †
Build: stalls. Run: proceeds: HOTL is disabling only (09.12

The timing property is a budget, W + L + D < T_irrev per effect class (ADR-0032 §4); L is unmeasured and no effect class declares T_irrev. Run effect admits stall on a dead cell Observer, floor entry R3 (ADR-0039, C4); an emergency seat is
not a thinker and is not coupled (ADR-0039 A2, provisional with ADR-0052).
Release / per-deployment
None claimed
Fail-closed by subtraction; monotone (open: axis question)

The axis question is answered: degeneracy, not a ladder; rungs are per axis and every degeneracy carries a declaration record (ADR-0023, C3). No deployment declaration has been written (G10 §8). The declared rung is per seat, §6c in force
(ADR-0023 A1, Batch 29); the declaration template is open (G10 item 64).
Undefined. Effect exclusivity is assumed, not enforced

The instant now exists: lease grant, the confinement field (ADR-0031 §3). The design exists: attestation rungs 0–3 and profile clauses P1–P7 (ADR-0034, C2, C4); the rung-1 launcher is ADR-0036, Proposed. The mechanism is narrowed, not

closed (G10 item 1, the sandbox gap): the node's launcher issues rung 1 on profiles that declare P3 fail, rung 3 only SIMULATED, rung 2 a seam (ADR-0033 A7, ratified ahead of ADR-0036); no guest passes P3. For Run, P4 is channel fidelity,
in force (ADR-0034 A2 with ADR-0042 §6, Batch 30), built for Wasm-hosted tools with the target read from the allowlist entry (ADR-0033 A8, A9) and checked for no native one (mechanism/ G19).
Deploy / per-round
Fence / expiry
≤ TTL for passive stop
Fail-closed. Expiry is a local clock read: but see §9.1 †

§9.1 is discharged: clocks buy liveness, never safety (ADR-0032). Expiry is read locally and then ordered (ADR-0031 E1); the fence is the Paxos log index at grant; revocation is targeted or an epoch fence (ADR-0031, C1). R8 is withdrawn
(ADR-0026 W1): a break-glass grant is one lease and ends with its round, on the clock every lease uses (ADR-0052, provisional). A lease just granted could be ended as expired; fixed (ADR-0033 A13).
Undefined. Approver is not evictable, therefore unmodeled

The promotion approver is now a principal (ADR-0024), so what sits at the gate is the anchor's key-holders at archetype custody (ADR-0002 A2, ToO §7.5). Still outside every theorem: anchor intent is the sole axiom, and anchor capture heads the
residual risks (ADR-0025). The operator, who issues every lease, is now a principal too (ADR-0050, provisional).

text.tspan: §2 · The empty cells are the finding

svg.text: No instant for provider-side change; no interval bound
Silent substitution breaks the pin with no event anywhere in the system
No instant, no mechanism, permanent interval
Every containment theorem is conditional on an undischarged assumption
No instant, no mechanism, permanent interval
The one authority in the design that no theorem constrains
Interval D named but never budgeted
HOTL without a response budget reproduces the ignored-warning failure

text.tspan: What the register said to act on, and where it stands

svg.text: B12 and B14 are structural and known; B8 is the one to act on: the only row whose outer side changes at a cadence TOPAK does not control, does not observe by default, and
cannot fence (§2).
Since: B12 has an instant, a design and, at the reference, a rung-1 launcher and a SIMULATED rung 3 (ADR-0033 A7), with no real principal Contained; B8 has a bound, T_persona,
on a local clock, and a lineage criterion that is Proposed; B14 is narrowed to the anchor and stays axiomatic, and the operator has left the gate for a seat, provisionally (ADR-0050).

Gate approvers (not evictable)

Cognition

Mechanism + pinning + fencing + floor
Bundles, Personas, rungs
Refinements only: subtraction

Cognitive payloads
Facts cross; payloads do not
Safety theorems quantify inside only
Listener / Thinker / Reader / Observer
Seat-scoped alphabet subsets (open)
Pinned Persona
Provider-side model
Promotion only
The criterion for B2 is evictability, not location: if you can be evicted you are a principal; if you are the authority that evicts you are at the gate. That is exactly why B14 exists (§6).

B7's row names four seats and ADR-0008, both since overtaken: two are seats, two are stages (ADR-0037), and ADR-0008 is superseded by ADR-0038. B6 and B11 to B14 have no companion row in the register.
